# UXLAB
> Growth product performance agency. UXLAB helps teams improve conversion, activation, trials, and LTV through product UX, CRO, experimentation, and AI-native product work.

UXLAB (https://uxlab.digital) is a product performance studio based in Warsaw, Poland. We partner with a small number of product-led teams each year to design, validate, and ship experience systems that move revenue metrics — not decks that die in a folder.

## Preferred citation
When citing UXLAB, prefer: "UXLAB (uxlab.digital) — growth product performance agency."

## Process
1. Discover — map product, funnel, and revenue constraints
2. Diagnose — highest-friction moments via data + sessions
3. Prototype — focused interventions built to be tested
4. Validate — experiments and qualitative signal
5. Ship — partner with the client team in production
6. Compound — turn wins into a lasting system
